ns2:section.sectionText: Fall ME 470 registration is for students whose UIN ends in an even number. To petition a change in this fall registration, please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu) . You will receive a TIME CONFLICT AND AN APPROVAL ERROR when registering for this course. To receive the necessary overrides to register, please contact the MechSE Undergraduate Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu). MechSE students must obtain department approval from staff the MechSE Undergraduate Office (mechse-ug-advise@illinois.edu) to drop this course after the first day of class. This section will have distributed classroom attendance (some attending Tuesday mornings and others Thursday mornings) with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from our department with specific attendance directives.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Senior class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Mechanical Sci & Engineering department.
